'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Giannetti LS Hoth: Echo Med Lab (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Joe Giannelli
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
